description: Day-ahead spot electricity prices for a bidding zone over a date range. Returns {unix_seconds, price, unit}; the price array is timestamp-aligned to unix_seconds. Prices in EUR/MWh.

end.description: Optional end date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

start.description: Optional start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 7 days ago.

name: electricity_price
title: Electricity Price
